data.title: Arachnid Protocol: New War Robot, Titan Weapon, Pilot, & Events (Aug 12–26)
data.summary: Stretch your legs in new events.
data.meta_title: Arachnid Protocol: New War Robot, Titan Weapon, Pilot, & Events (Aug 12–26)
data.content:
Activate the Arachnid Protocol, a new limited-time event active from August 12–26. Catch enemies in the deadly webs of Anansi, spin up a new Titan Weapon for Matriarch, let the new Legendary Pilot Carmen Ruiz take control, and much more.

Anansi: Attack From Above With A New War Robot & Weapon

Trap your enemies in your web with the new Tactician-class spider War Robot. Anansi boasts high maneuverability, letting it quickly seize the high ground before homing in on targets from afar. Equip Anansi with the new MLx2 Weapon, a Heavy Rocket Launcher. Lock onto targets and launch a hail of missiles.

Weave Camouflage Web (Core Gear), which renders allies within the radius invisible to enemies, allowing for tactical pushes or retreats.

Anansi is now available in the Store and Daily Deals.

Pilot Party Event: More XP (August 12–19)

Earn 50% more Pilot XP from Matchmaking Battles. Take advantage of this opportunity to improve your Pilot Ranks and try out new Talents.

New Titan Weapon: Scrubber for Matriarch

Load up Matriarch with a new Titan Weapon. Scrubber is a medium-range kinetic autocannon with a massive ammo capacity, able to shred through foes with ease. Matriarch needs two Scrubber Weapons, so get your hands on them while you can!

Scrubber is available in Daily Deals with a boosted chance to obtain it from August 12–19, and as part of other offers.

Intel Upgrade Discount Event (August 12–26)

It’s time to upgrade! Until August 26, the Intel cost for upgrading will be reduced. Check out the discounted items below:

  • War Robot Modules: Tyr, Fury, Scorpion
  • Titan: Grim
  • Weapons: Pulsar, Tusk, Jigsaw, Katzbalger, Vortex
  • Gear: Repulsor, Homing Missile, Blink, Gamma Beam, Ghost Turret

New Legendary Pilot: Carmen Ruiz

The daughter of the Freecon CEO, Carmen Ruiz, has skills to pay the bills and is desperate to prove herself on the battlefield. Equipped with defense-heavy Talents, she can boost shield regeneration, rate of fire, and reduce cooldowns.  

Carmen Ruiz is now available in the Store.

Credit Exchange

Load up. Every 12 hours starting from August 14, head to the Store and exchange 10 Credits for a random reward, including Credits, Salvage, Intel, and Premium time.

Animated Wrap: Spirit Core (August 12–26)

Add dynamic style to your War Robots with the Spirit Core Animated Wrap! Adorn your War Robots with this starry-night-inspired Wrap, pulsing in time with the universe and showing off your sparkling personality.

The Spirit Core Wrap is now available in the Store.

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:

Stay tuned to our official X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok channels, and join the War Robots: Frontiers subreddit and Discord for all the latest news and updates.
